picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, links national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery platform — a rare top-down federal strategy for accelerating science with AI.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions marks one of the most ambitious applications of generative AI to fundamental physics research to date.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's reported use of thousands of autonomous agents to produce a proof addressing part of the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem would be a landmark demonstration of AI contributing original results to one of mathematics' hardest open questions.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ universities, with Vanderbilt as a founding member, to build shared advanced computing infrastructure signals a coordinated national push to expand academic AI compute capacity.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5 million NIA grant extends UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's AI center for aging and Alzheimer's care, sustaining a major federally backed effort to apply AI to a growing public health crisis.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federal grant for the multi-institution NATIVE-ID project, including Brown's work on machine learning models of protein misfolding, represents significant investment in AI-driven neurodegenerative disease research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model dramatically speeds up prediction of protein motion compared to traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a genuine methodological advance with broad implications for drug discovery and structural biology.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: A cross-institutional team from MIT, CMU, NYU, and Stanford built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark result for imperfect-information game AI with implications for real-world decision-making under uncertainty.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: A State Department-funded innovation lab led by the University of Florida builds an international AI-enabled biosecurity network across seven countries, illustrating how AI research funding is increasingly tied to foreign policy and food security goals.
picks.title: University of Florida to lead new Feed the Future Innovation Lab for High-Value Crops

picks.editorial_note: UVM reported record research funding of $222.6 million, including a $38 million contract — its largest ever — underscoring the scale of institutional investment flowing into AI-adjacent research infrastructure.
picks.title: UVM Board of Trustees’ Fall Meeting Highlights Research…
